objective: CUT-BOXES-20261127-001 found the step one layer up (boxes) only on closed systems, which ordinary growth never makes. The rival laws A129 (one_fewer) and A130 (arity_floor) let births take fewer fresh distinctions, so growth can close a stage. On every census start, grow under each rival law to round 6; collect the stages that become closed after at least one round; search them in full for boxes with a birth's law needed.
title: Under the forbidding cuts, does growth close a stage that carries the step one layer up?
